thread.title: MARKETS: Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigns over relationship scandal, chipmaker raises Q2 guidance

title: MARKETS: Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigns over relationship scandal, chipmaker raises Q2 guidance
text: Yahoo Finance Video • June 21, 2018 Yahoo Finance's Alexis Christoforous and Jared Blikre break down the latest market action after Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigns after an investigation determined he had an inappropriate, consensual affair with an employee. In other news, the company also raised guidance for the second quarter.
